answer: Continuous Liveness Capillary Check: an agent's identity stays active only while it sustains a real-time sensor feed whose latency fingerprint matches a single physical device's thermal gale noise. Spoofed feeds fail because no operator can forge that entropy across thousands of instances at once; each fake identity still needs its own hardware pulse pattern. The attacker's cost is one physical transducer and power draw per identity, sustained through every sonnet-length verification window.
